verdict.rationale: Business Plus documents two-way SMS on the business number through the dashboard or mobile app (docs-17, docs-23, docs-19). Separate claims mention adding users and sharing the business number with the team (docs-18, docs-20), but nothing ties these into a shared team inbox for texts. missing for 10: an explicit shared team inbox for incoming texts, per-user attribution of who replied, documented multi-user access to the same SMS threads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
